articles.title: Pro Dota 2 Player Claims He Had to Play a Full Match in Front of Police Officers to Prove His Identity
articles.summary: A pro Dota 2 player is claiming that he had to play a full Dota match in front of police officers to prove his identity. According to Nuengnara "23savage" Teeramahanon, who currently plays hard carry for Xipto eSports, the team’s boot camp in Kuala Lumpur was raided by police Sunday evening.
body: The officers proceeded to interrogate the players about why they were in the city and whether they were really pro players. According to 23savage, one of the officers was familiar with Dota, and was willing to scroll the player’s Instagram for proof of his pro career.

A photo 23savage had recently posted of himself and popular Malaysian influencer Ms. Puiyi was, according to the post, somewhat acceptable evidence. Enough evidence, in fact, for the police officers to remove his handcuffs and test what really mattered: how good he is at defending the ancients.

23savage proceeded to start up a Dota match right in front of the police officers, dropping 23 kills as the hard carry Kez. The Dota player alleges that this was enough proof to convince the officers to let the team go, and also that they stole two jars of Nutella on their way out.

Commenters on the post quickly doubted 23savage’s claims, presuming the post to be a joke, but 23savage has been actively defending his story in the replies. Reddit users continue to doubt the hard carry player, while others jokingly claim 23savage’s story is saving Valve’s MOBA.

articles.title: Why Rockstar Canceled Its PlayStation-Exclusive Follow-Up To GTA 4
articles.summary: At E3 2009, Sony announced that it was partnering with Rockstar on a PlayStation-exclusive spy game called Agent, with Rockstar founders Sam and Dan Houser overseeing development. The game never materialized, though, and now Dan Houser has shared more details as to why.
body: Speaking to IGN, Houser said Agent never coming out shouldn't be a total shock because he worked on "a bunch of games that never came out." He said Rockstar tried with two or three different teams to make Agent--an open-world spy game--but the teams just "could not get it right."
"And it never came out. We concluded that it was not a game we were ever going to figure out how to make. Other people can try, but I personally think it's hard," he said.
Great spy movies like the James Bond series work so well because they take viewers all over the world, but "that's not an experience in an open-world game that really works," Houser said.
"So we tried lots of things and couldn't get it quite right," Houser said, going on to say that the teams built great elements but they never came together in a full package.

articles.title: Mortal Kombat Creator Ed Boon Responds to Street Fighter Cast Saying They Want a Crossover Movie
articles.summary: Mortal Kombat co-creator Ed Boon has responded after the cast of the Street Fighter movie were vocally enthusiastic about the idea of making a crossover film with Mortal Kombat, and it looks like he’s open to the possibility, too — as long as a game gets made first.
body: I got the chance to chat with the cast of the Street Fighter movie ahead of its October 16 release, and many of the actors involved told me they’re absolutely game for a crossover with the Mortal Kombat films. In fact, Andrew Schulz joked that this was the real goal of his infamous jab at the MK cast during the 2025 Game Awards.

“I want more Street Fighter,” Noah Centineo, who plays Ken, added. “If you bring an opportunity to us to be able to come back and reup these incredible characters, I’m down, and I know we’re all down. So if that’s Mortal Kombat, if that’s me kicking Thor in his face, you know?”
It wasn’t long before Ed Boon himself became aware of these comments, which he responded to in a post on Twitter/X. “Game first... then movie,” he wrote alongside a winky face emoticon.

While Boon is probably just trolling, this isn’t the first time he’s mentioned the idea of Street Fighter and Mortal Kombat colliding; in May 2026, he tweeted about wanting a Street Fighter guest character in a Mortal Kombat game, saying he was a “huge fan” of the series.

articles.title: RuneScape Reignited Canceled Less Than Two Weeks After Being Announced
articles.summary: Creative director Mod Ryan announced that RuneScape Reignited, a new game mode designed for both old and seasoned players to start fresh, has been canceled less than two weeks after it was first announced.
body: The news was published on October 15 in the form of an official YouTube video and blog post, where Mod Ryan revealed that Jagex’s choice to cancel Reignited was in direct response to player feedback.

“We received a ton of different perspectives from all of you, and we truly appreciate everyone sharing their views. It is super important to us because the last time we didn't listen to player feedback, combat changed forever. And it has taken us over a decade to recover from that. Now I said on stage that we would not repeat the same mistakes of the past, and I truly stand by that. Considering this, we have made the decision to cancel Reignited,” the post reads.

“It is clear that we missed the mark on this, and so we are not moving forward with it. Our goal is to see RuneScape grow again, with returning players coming back and new players joining, but never at the expense of our existing community.”

articles.title: Call Of Duty: MW4 Is Not On Xbox Game Pass, But Here’s When You Can Expect It
articles.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is set for release on October 23, and in a big shakeup, it will not be available on Xbox Game Pass at launch. This has been known for a while, but Activision is reminding people of this in a new blog post on the eve of the game's campaign early access on October 16.
body: Upon release, the only way to get MW4 is by purchasing it outright, starting at $70 for the base edition and scaling to $100 for the Vault edition.
Activision said MW4 will be available on Xbox Game Pass at some point at the end of next year, meaning it will be "windowed" as a standalone purchase for about one year.

2024’s Black Ops 6 was the first entry in the series to launch directly into Xbox Game Pass, with Black Ops 7 following the same playbook in 2025. However, Microsoft announced earlier this year that new Call of Duty titles would no longer debut in Game Pass, an announcement it made in conjunction with a price cut for the subscription service.

Microsoft has never explicitly said why it made this major change, but it could have to do with lost sales. It was reported that Black Ops 6 coming to Game Pass in 2024 amounted to Microsoft missing out on hundreds of millions of dollars in revenue. That number has been debated, and it does not tell the whole story, but no doubt there was a financial impact that Microsoft is responding to.
points: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is set for release on October 23, and in a big shakeup, it will not be available on Xbox Game Pass at launch.

articles.title: 007 First Light On Switch 2 Includes Something No Other Platform Gets, And It’s Ridiculous
articles.summary: IO Interactive has announced the release date for 007 First Light's long-delayed Switch 2 version--March 18, 2027--and that's not all. People who preorder the game for Switch 2 are getting something no other platform has: a ridiculously oversized tie.
body: Not just any ridiculously oversized tie, however. People who preorder First Light for Switch 2 get the GoldenEye Suit, and it includes the suit and tie that Pierce Brosnan wore in the famous 1995 movie, including the oversized tie.
Brosnan wore a lot of suits in that movie, but the one being referenced here is the one with the oversized tie, which was the style at the time.

GoldenEye has a special history with Nintendo specifically, which may help explain why Switch 2 owners are getting this outfit and no one else is. After all, 1997's GoldenEye 007, which was based on the movie, is one of the most iconic N64 games of all time.
First Light has been a big hit, critically and commercially, scoring great reviews and selling more than 4 million copies, and that's before the Switch 2 version even comes out.

articles.title: The Mummy Officially Returns in 1 Year — Now With a New Cryptic Title
articles.summary: Mark your calendars, because the 27-year-old The Mummy franchise officially returns exactly one year from today. To mark the occasion, Universal Pictures finally revealed the title for the next The Mummy movie.
body: The Mummy: Book of the Dead will reunite Rachel Weisz's Evie Carnahan and Brendan Fraser's Rick O'Connell after Weisz (wisely) sat out the third film and Evie was recast with Maria Bello taking on the role. Recent set photos of a very stylish Weisz have indicated that Book of the Dead might take place in the late 1950s. Other photos have shown Fraser's new look as O'Connell. But, now that the official title has been revealed, there's still one major question we're wondering.

The first two The Mummy movies center around titular mummy Imhotep and his attempts at coming back to life. He's resurrected via the Book of the Dead, so the subtitle for the next movie highly implies he'll be a key figure in The Mummy: Book of the Dead.

articles.title: GTA 6 Isn’t Showing Boobie In Promotional Material
articles.summary: The marketing machine for Grand Theft Auto 6 is at full steam, and while Rockstar Games is showcasing many of the characters players will be encountering in the open-world crime game, one character with a very distinct name has been largely absent from promos.
body: Viewers of the GTA 6 Extended Look might have been snickering every time protagonists Jason and Lucia uttered the word "Boobie," but the official GTA 6 website indicates that the character of Boobie Ike is a Vice City powerhouse. Though he's implied to be a highly influential figure in the game's story, he hasn't made an appearance in any trailers.

Boobie is the owner of the Jack of Hearts club, seen in the extended look trailer. His "legitimate empire" also includes real estate investments and a recording studio, and in his words, "the drug money pay for it all." The first segment of the extended look video has Jason and Lucia making a pickup on behalf of Boobie, and simply saying his name was enough to grant them access.

The lack of Boobie in any GTA 6 trailers does prompt curiosity about his larger role in the story. It has already been the subject of speculation in social media posts and YouTube videos, with some predicting that he'll turn out to be an antagonist who double-crosses Jason and Lucia. It's also possible that Boobie's presence in the story will be by name only, as he pulls strings from the background.

articles.title: How to unlock fast travel in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
articles.summary: Fast travel is tucked away until you make a fair amount of progress in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse. If you want to revisit old haunts in the early game and uncover treasures you missed, you'll have to go on foot — or just hold off for a couple of hours.
body: Below, we explain when you unlock fast travel in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse and how it works.

Fast travel unlocks automatically when you meet the Boatman, though that won't happen for a while. The door that takes you to one of his ferry stops is tucked away deep in the Catacombs. You can only access the catacombs after defeating three bosses around Paris — Medusa, Joan at the top of Prison Tower, and The Fallen — and obtaining their emblems.

Vast and imposing as the catacombs are, there's only one way down. Follow the path into the depths, using the green wall markers as a guide if you ever get turned around or lose your way. Make sure to open the pathways back to the mirror room as you descend, so you can quickly return to and from the depths via elevator.

body: My condition for Eshmel joining the fray is that they aren't just another Byleth. No giving them the powers of the Flame Lords as their attacks just to get all the main faces in! Not when Eshmel has a unique fighting style (that almost certainly points to their identity in a former life ). Trident is a nifty class, too. It specializes in spear work, which would be a first for the sword-loving Smash Bros, and it has access to some pretty helpful white magic, too. Robin already has the self-healing Nosferatu spell, so I'm not keen on repeating that. Seraphim is essential given how prominent the undead are in Fortune's Weave, and maybe some of those fancy starlight spells Orchel and Aurora get.

articles.title: Less than 2 weeks after announcing RuneScape Reignited, Jagex is scrapping the whole thing
articles.summary: Life comes at you fast, as the saying goes, and the folks at RuneScape developer Jagex can sure attest to that. Less than two weeks after announcing RuneScape Reignited —essentially a way for new and lapsed players to restart their adventures from fresh on separate, unique servers—the studio has…
body: There was trouble with RuneScape Reignited almost right from the start, with complaints ranging from a potential community split to restrictions on character interactions and the need to pay for a separate subscription. Just a few days after the initial announcement, Jagex apologized for making veteran players feel like they were being shunted aside, and said it was "exploring a heavy set of revisions to Reignited based on your feedback."

A few days after that, it laid out a more specific list of intended alterations, and invited more feedback from players, "so we can follow up next week with more of our thoughts." With that feedback now received, it seems that Jagex has heard enough. "It is clear that we missed the mark on this, and so we are not moving forward with it," Mod Ryan—associate creative director Ryan Philpott—said in a blog post announcing the cancellation. "Our goal is to see Runescape grow again, with returning players coming back and new players joining, but never at the expense of our existing community."

articles.title: 2026's Bloodiest Game Just Got a Release Date
articles.summary: While big gaming showcases like The Game Awards are packed full of big-budget games, they usually feature plenty of exciting indies, too. Acts of Blood was spotlighted at last year's Summer Game Fest, and it immediately piqued our interest.
body: On Wednesday, developer Eksil Team announced that Acts of Blood will be released for Windows PC on Dec. 4. It was previously only officially announced for PC, but Eksil Team has good news for console gamers too: Acts of Blood will land on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X sometime in 2027.

If you don't want to wait, you can get a taste of Acts of Blood 's combat in its demo on Steam. That demo has over 1,500 Very Positive player reviews, with players enjoying its brutal combat. "Great animations, weighty feeling combat, and simple but meaningful feeling combos," one player wrote in their review. " The Raid is a freaking AWESOME movie and now you can play it," another said.

When justice fails, Hendra embarks on a personal quest for revenge that will take him through the bustling streets of Bandapa, Indonesia to uncover the powerful group behind his family’s murder and make them pay for their actions.
Learn, develop and improve Hendra’s combat skills, unlock punishing new moves, and become a martial arts master to beat down waves of enemies, defeat powerful bosses, and avenge your family.

articles.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave gets its first wave of DLC today, and an expansion pass to include it
articles.summary: Nintendo and Intelligent Systems have released an expansion pass for Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, introducing a string of DLC additions to the tactical RPG starting today, and through into 2027.
body: The expansion pass, which can be bought on the Nintendo eShop for $34.99 / £29.99, comes in three parts. For those who buy it now, a selection of weapons are made available to use within the game. The second part of the expansion pass arrives this holiday season, and the final part arrives in 2027.
We already know a bit about what's coming in these latter DLC releases. The second portion features additional outfits for the game's cast, alongside three new allies: Aurora, Smyrnos, and Jurah.

The final segment of the pass looks to be the most substantial; introducing new stories to play, new allies, classes, and additional goodies. Those new stories make an already chunky game even larger, something that should give people a reason to go back to the RPG next year, and those yet to pick up the game, a convenient jumping-on point.

Fortune's Weave has been met with critical acclaim and sizable early sales figures. In Eurogamer's review, the game is described as "a synergy of everything that has made the series great for generations", and "a sumptuous feast of a game".

articles.title: Control Resonant sells 1 million copies in 3 weeks to become Remedy's fastest-selling game ever
articles.summary: Remedy announced today that Control Resonant has surpassed one million copies sold, moving past Alan Wake 2 to become "the fastest-selling game in Remedy Entertainment's 31-year history." Thank you for the support ❤️ For playing, sharing, and being a part of the community.#CONTROLResonant.
body: Three weeks to a million copies isn't exactly a blistering pace by conventional videogame standards: The Blood of Dawnwalker hit the mark in three days, Wardogs did it in one, and Subnautica 2 put out twice that number in just 12 hours.

But despite producing a string of unique, memorable, and critically acclaimed games, Remedy has never really smashed a massive home run in the sales department. Even Alan Wake 2, which won numerous awards for narrative and art direction in 2023 (and would have claimed so many more if not for the Baldur's Gate 3 behemoth) took two months to sell a million copies, significantly outpacing the original Control and making it the studio's fastest-selling game at that time.

Remedy's more pressing problem, though, is profit: It took more than a year, and two million copies sold, before Alan Wake 2 actually started making money for Remedy. Addressing that shortcoming was the top priority for Jean-Charles Gaudechon, who took over as the company's new CEO in February: Remedy chairman Henri Österlund said at the time that Gaudechon's appointment was intended "to lead Remedy into a phase of profitable growth."
